THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 7
Land Ministry Ref. No.: 4-3/6/2014/HW/360.
My Reference No.: 4/3/1/138.
I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 ofthe Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends toacquire the following lands which are required for a publicpurpose.
Description of the land to be acquired:

Lot Nos. 1 to 14 (Lots 14) allotments in Total Extent of about0.0967 Hectare, of land in Preliminary Plan No. Ka. 4579 anddated 27.07.2016, prepared by the Senior Superintendent ofSurveys, Kaluthara on behalf of the Surveyor General situatedin the Village of Diyagama in the Grama Niladhari Division ofNo. 713 Diyagama and Divisional Secretary's Division ofKaluthara in Kaluthara District in Western Province.
